Static or dynamic — which does a sale need?

Static for the coupon code itself: it carries the code as text and never expires. Dynamic for anything that changes — the sale page, hourly drops, stock that sells out. Dynamic codes are free with a sign-in, and currently unlimited for a limited time.
Can I change where a printed code points?
Yes — that’s what dynamic means here. Edit the destination from your dashboard any time; the printed code never changes.
What happens to my codes after the sale?
Nothing expires. Repoint dynamic codes to your next campaign, and keep the posters for next year — same codes, new offers.
How big should a window poster code be?
Big enough to scan through glass from the sidewalk — 10 cm (4 in) or more. Our blog’s print size guide has the full distance table.
